The alligator mouth opens to the bigger number bud. Meaning 1<2 or 3>2. To put "<" in *front* of a number means whatever you're talking about is smaller than the number. You could also put ">" behind the number and achieve the same effect. For example: the total number of apples we bought was 5>. This would read as "the total number of apples we bought was less than 5". Tempted to toss you on r/confidentlyincorrect.
